name: Data pack
summary: A data pack for Minecraft: Java Edition: functions that run on load and every tick, with the right pack format and folder names for the chosen version.
description: A folder that goes straight into a world's datapacks folder. Nothing to build. The pack format number and the shape of pack.mcmeta are set for the Minecraft version you pick, because a wrong number or an old folder name makes the game skip the pack without an error.

options.label: Pack name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter, at least two characters; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only
options.help: The namespace is this name in lower case with underscores (My Pack becomes my_pack). Functions are then called my_pack:name.

options.label: Description
options.help: Shown in the data pack list in game.

options.label: Minecraft version
options.help: Sets the pack format in pack.mcmeta. All of these use the singular folder names (function, advancement, recipe, loot_table).

options.label: Example advancement
options.help: An advancement that runs a function when you pick up dirt.

options.label: Example recipe
options.help: A crafting recipe: one dirt makes one diamond.

options.label: Example loot table
options.help: A loot table you can roll with the /loot command.

next: Copy the whole folder into the datapacks folder of a world: .minecraft\saves\<world>\datapacks
Open the world, or run /reload if it is already open (cheats must be on).
Run /datapack list and look for the pack in the enabled list. After /reload its loaded message shows in chat.
Run /function with the pack's hello function to see it work.
Your commands go into the .mcfunction files under data\<namespace>\function.
